احتفرن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَفَرْنَ (iḥtafarna) /iħ.ta.far.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# اُحْتُفِرْنَ (uḥtufirna) /uħ.tu.fir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
# اِحْتَفِرْنَ (iḥtafirna) /iħ.ta.fir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْتَفَرَ (iḥtafara)
